name: B-Team Dilemma System
description: Craig Jones’s Systematic Submission Dilemmas covers triangle entries, triangle finishing problems, leg-lock transitions and rolling commentary.
summary: Triangle variations and leg entanglements connected through upper- and lower-body attacks.
overview: Systematic Submission Dilemmas brings together Craig Jones’s triangle variations, leg-lock attacks and transitions between them. Entries from guard and top position sit alongside specific defensive problems and commentary on recorded rounds. Its focus is the connection between upper- and lower-body attacks within one course.

products.title: Systematic Submission Dilemmas: High Level Triangle and Leg Lock Combos
products.blurb: An eight-volume course combining triangles, leg attacks, positional entries and recorded-round commentary.
products.best_for: Grapplers interested in linking upper- and lower-body submissions.

guide.display_title: Craig Jones: Triangle and Leg-Lock Combinations

fits: You want to connect triangle attacks with leg entanglements.
You want triangle entries from both guard and top positions, with troubleshooting beyond the initial entry.
consider_alternative_if: You want a short course devoted to a single triangle variation or one leg lock.

includes: Front, rear, reverse and side triangles, including responses to the defensive problems named for each.
Triangle entries from open guard, closed guard, knee shields and top positions.
Transitions into 50/50, X-guard and ashi garami, plus commentary on recorded rounds.
limits: The eight-volume course combines several submission families; it is not a general guard-retention, passing or back-control curriculum.
